externalData.transferConcern: Database rows contain object paths, stable media URLs, image URLs, and media metadata whose referenced blobs live outside PostgreSQL. A future plan must inventory/copy objects and validate referential reachability separately.

Provider credentials, OAuth client secrets, webhook secrets, VAPID keys, encryption/session material, and job secrets are environment/integration configuration, not row data to copy blindly. No secret value was read.

Brevo, Infobip/SMS, Google/Facebook OAuth, Cloudflare, web push, arbitrary validated external media/video URLs, and Unsplash-backed legacy media require explicit target configuration and post-transfer validation without copying secret material.
